scenes.heading: OPENMONTAGE TURNS YOUR AI INTO A *VIDEO STUDIO*
scenes.say: You already pay for an AI coding assistant. This open source project turns it into a full video studio.
{OpenMontage|Open Montage} passed sixty seven thousand stars in about six months, and the licence is AGPL.

scenes.heading: WHAT'S *INSIDE*
scenes.say: Inside: a dozen production pipelines, more than a hundred tools and seven hundred skill files, driven from the assistant you already use.

scenes.title: Quick start
scenes.heading: SETUP: *TWO* COMMANDS
scenes.say: Setup is a clone and make setup. Then you just describe the video you want.
The agent researches your topic with live search, writes and narrates the script, finds free music, adds word level subtitles, then checks its own render with ffprobe and frame sampling.

scenes.heading: THE *CATCH*
cons: Best models need paid API keys
pros: Zero-key mode: offline voice + open footage
Runs in Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex
scenes.say: The catch: it is AGPL licensed, the best models need paid keys, and there are many moving parts. But it is free, there is a zero key mode with offline narration and open footage, and it runs inside the assistant you already have.
Would you make videos this way? Comment Montage and I will pin the repo.

youtube.title: OpenMontage: Turn Your AI Coder Into a Video Studio
youtube.description:
OpenMontage turns Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or Codex into an agentic video studio: 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools and 700+ skill files, with a zero-key mode that narrates offline via Piper TTS, pulls open footage from Archive.org, NASA and Wikimedia, and renders with Remotion/HyperFrames and FFmpeg. Setup is a clone and make setup. 67,156 GitHub stars as of 12 October 2026; AGPL-3.0.
Source: https://github.com/calesthio/OpenMontage
